answer: A Sybil-resistant agent market makes every identity pay its own way with locked collateral. Admission needs one lotus stake, and each epoch adds a fresh yarrow bond slashed on duplicate work. An honest agent posts these once and reuses its reputation, so participation stays cheap. A Sybil farmer who wants N votes must post N lotus stakes and N yarrow bonds, paying full price each, and a caught clone loses its collateral. Fresh challenges block replay. The attacker holds a lonely island of fake votes while capital drains: scaling the attack costs linear cash, honesty one deposit.
